meta.tagline: In loving memory of Gefen Aviram
meta.description: Gefen's Starlight Foundation honours the memory of Gefen Aviram by funding martial-arts programmes for children and youth at risk, teaching perseverance, determination and hope.

home.heroTitle: Every child deserves a star of their own
home.heroLead: The foundation gives children and youth at risk a place in a martial-arts group, and the routine of showing up — week after week.
home.focusBody: The foundation allows children and youth at risk to be part of a group in a martial-arts club and to take part regularly in meetings and events. By drawing them into a sport they come to love, we aim to instil perseverance, commitment, sportsmanship and dedication — to raise their sense of worth, encourage positive action and a striving for excellence, and give them a strong sense of self-efficacy.
home.ctaBody: Every donation turns directly into training hours, equipment, and a sense of belonging for a child who needs it.
home.galleryTeaserBody: Smiles, new belts, and children discovering what they are capable of.
